dancing.notes: A party cover band. Captions on its own video page talk about songs that keep the crowd dancing and moving.

description: A Long Island cover band formed in 2017 that plays as a trio up to a six-piece, mixing classic rock, country, Motown, R&B, Top 40 and some disco.
reviewNotes: Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). A different 'Mach 5' rock band is in Austin, TX (mach5atx.com). Tiki Joe's Captree gig not confirmed on the band site. Social links not found on the site.
